name: iDICE Startup Bridge
eligibility: CAC registration, Nigerian founder, tech or digital startup, MVP preferred
description: Federal Government digital & creative startup program offering funding, training, and investor access.
success_tips: Highlight traction metrics (users, MRR), show clear market need, include a strong go-to-market plan.

name: iDICE Founders Lab
eligibility: Idea-stage founders, Nigerian citizens, digital/tech focus
description: Idea-stage support program for early founders to validate business models and build MVPs.
success_tips: Show problem–solution clarity, include wireframes, emphasize founder–market fit.

name: iDICE Growth Lab
eligibility: Post-MVP, traction required, CAC registration, financial records
description: Scale-up program for startups with traction; includes governance training and fundraising readiness.
success_tips: Show revenue growth, retention metrics, and scalability of your SaaS architecture.

name: Tony Elumelu Foundation (TEF) Entrepreneurship Programme
eligibility: 18+, African founder, early-stage business, CAC registration optional
description: Pan-African entrepreneurship program supporting early-stage founders with seed capital, training, and mentorship.
success_tips: Tell a compelling founder story, show community impact, keep your business model simple and clear.

name: Bank of Industry SME Grants
eligibility: CAC registration, business plan, financial statements
sector: SaaS (if job-creation or digital infrastructure), tech-enabled SMEs
description: Government-backed funding for SMEs in manufacturing, tech, agriculture, and creative sectors.
success_tips: Provide a strong financial model and demonstrate job creation or digital transformation impact.

name: NIRSAL AGSMEIS
eligibility: CAC registration, training certificate from approved EDI
sector: SaaS (if supporting SMEs or agriculture value chain)
description: Agric and SME-focused funding for equipment, expansion, and working capital.
success_tips: Show how your SaaS product supports SMEs or agriculture efficiency.

name: Youth Entrepreneurship Support (YES) Programme
eligibility: Nigerian youth 18–35, business idea or existing startup
description: Training and seed support for Nigerian youth building SMEs.
success_tips: Focus on job creation, youth empowerment, and digital innovation.

name: AECF Energy Transition Challenge
eligibility: African startup, clean energy focus, 1:1 matching funds
sector: SaaS (energy analytics, IoT dashboards, climate tech)
description: Clean energy and climate-focused grant requiring matching funds for scalable energy solutions.
success_tips: Show measurable climate impact, energy efficiency metrics, and scalability.
